system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you would summon two or more Bunshin, you can spend a superiority die as a part of the casting. When you do, you instead only summon one. This Bunshin has a number of hit points equal to 5 times the result of the spent Superiority Die. This summon also can cast +1 additional jutsu. This Bunshin adds 1d8 to all damage it deals once per turn. You can only have One Bunshin created by this Maneuver active at a time.
